property_summary: For every uint input _val, the correct contract stores MinSum exactly equal to _val after SetMinSum(_val) completes; the mutant that assigns MinSum = ~_val + 1 will store a different value for at least some _val (e.g., any non-zero value), so there exists inputs where c.MinSum() != _val.
change_summary: Negate the parameter when assigning so MinSum is set to the unsigned wrap of -_val (i.e., MaxUint - _val + 1), producing a very different stored MinSum for most inputs.
